$comment: Profiles: ready-made selections of this library, each for one kind of work. An install that names one (--profile <name>, MCP_PROMPTS_PROFILE, or ?profile=<name> in an HTTP URL) serves only these prompts, so list_prompts returns a fraction of the library. Entries are groups (directories), prompt ids or tag:<tag>, as for --prompts and --templates; 'prompts' lists plain prompts and 'templates' lists templates. Run 'mcp-prompts profiles' to see what each serves and which prompts are in none.

software-dev.description: Analysing and reviewing a software project: an orchestrator per project type and the architecture, security and test analysts.

embedded-iot.description: Firmware, Raspberry Pi and Android work and the bridges between devices, with the MIA repository's pull-request workflow.

mia-vehicle.description: The MIA in-car assistant at run time: climate, diagnostics, maintenance, navigation, emergencies, car voice and GPIO.

voice-home.description: Voice-command understanding and home automation: MIA voice intelligence, the OpenClaw agents and the home command interpreter.

android-automation.description: Natural-language control of an Android phone: agents that drive specific apps through android-control, Termux and termux-* commands, the Termux/PRoot bridge, and end-to-end scenarios such as Deep Research to an audio overview in a notebook, the MQTT phone event bus that agents wait on instead of polling, and the router that turns a typed, spoken or agent request into the right layer. Combine with tasker-automation for Tasker work.

claude-panel.description: The Claude Panel on the phone: route a dictated or typed task to a repository question, a bug fix or a coding task for local Claude Code, which answers or opens a draft pull request. Combine with android-automation (android-automation,claude-panel) for the phone's agents.

tasker-automation.description: Building and maintaining Tasker on Android: project architecture, profiles and contexts, scene design/XML, tasks and action codes, variables and secrets policy, config audits and safe direct edits of Tasker's config. Combine with android-automation for the full phone stack.

android-phone.description: Full phone stack in one profile: every android-automation prompt and template (the router, app agents, Termux, PRoot, scenarios, the event bus) plus all seven Tasker templates and the tasker-scene-xml prompt. Use this when the voice pipeline or a phone agent needs both the android-automation and the tasker-automation selections without passing two profile names. Pairs with --profile android-phone in mcp-prompts-http or the MCP_PROMPTS_PROFILE env var in the voice pipeline. For panel (Claude Code on the phone) add claude-panel: --profile android-phone,claude-panel.

learning-loop.description: The self-improvement loop: the seven cognitive-layer instructions and the analyzer that turns results into learnings.

liberty-citations.description: Czech libertarian writing backed by verified, page-cited quotes, for the liberty-citations skill and its toolkit: the router, the citation rules and tool reference, finding and checking quotes, Czech texts with drug prohibition as home turf, Stoky posts from idea to submission, the Fórum Svobodného přístavu on Facebook, timestamped quotes from Kanál Svobodného přístavu videos, parody dabing subtitles, and toolkit setup and corpus upkeep.
